short_description:
GTA VI leads The Game Awards 2026 with 8 nominations, the most of any game, including Game of the Year and Best Game Direction. The Game of the Year nominees: 007 First Light, Control Resonant, Grand Theft Auto VI, Phantom Blade Zero, Resident Evil Requiem and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake. Winners are announced December 10 in Los Angeles. Our call: GTA 6 wins it. Yours?

Sources: VGC, Gematsu, GosuGamers, Wccftech, Exputer.
